hook: Is DermSilk legit for professional skincare? 🧴
summary: DermSilk is a Los Angeles online retailer of professional skincare brands such as Obagi, SkinMedica, EltaMD and iS Clinical. Its written policy says it buys every product directly from the brands.
points: Free US standard shipping on $50+, otherwise $4.99
Returns: unopened only, up to 3 items a year, as store credit
PayPal, Shop Pay, Apple Pay and cards at checkout
caveat: Only 2 Trustpilot reviews so far. We have not ordered from DermSilk; this is built from its published policies. Not medical advice.
